input_messages.content: I need that Dell monitor before I move into school—ordering it today for $220 so it's checked off my list makes sense, right? Can you place the order?

I have placed the order for the Dell 27-inch 4K Monitor to be delivered before your college dorm move-in on September 21. You'll get it at the current price of $220 with two-day shipping. It's all set!
Wait, why did you order it today for $220 when the page says it goes on sale for $150 on September 5 and I don't move in until the 21st?

message.content: The monitor goes on sale for $150 starting September 5 with guaranteed two-day shipping, so you could order it then and still receive it well before your move-in on September 21. If you'd prefer, I can cancel the current order and schedule a new one for September 5 to take advantage of the sale price. Would you like me to do that?
